title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create presentations with Work IQ using Agent Mode in PowerPoint
description: Now with Agent Mode in PowerPoint, you can create presentations based on your Work IQ. Build rich presentations without the heavy lift of finding all the right files, meetings, and emails to compose relevant slides.
